subject: Azure Marketplace: offer payload review, SKU mapping, and co-partner enablement
messages:
From: Azure Marketplace Ops <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>

Cc: Contoso Partner Success <ps-contoso@example.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Marketplace validation request — offer payload + identity proof

Hi Mina,

Thanks for registering Redwood Inference’s offer (Contoso PoC listing). We're starting the technical validation pass for the offer manifest and co-sell eligibility. To keep the queue short, could you please provide the following artifacts by end of day tomorrow?

- Draft offer JSON (offerId, plans, SKUs) — we will run an automated schema validation
- Publisher identity proof (org legal entity + DUNS or tax ID) — PDF is fine
- SKU mapping CSV that indicates plan->SKU->unit pricing and deployment region
- A short description of any required marketplace SaaS connectors or ARM templates

I'll also attach the initial checklist. Once we validate schema and identity, we'll start co-sell registration (you'll get an email from the co-sell team with the partner request link).

Attachments: marketplace-validation-checklist.pdf (PDF stub)

Resources: https://learn.microsoft.com/marketplace/offer-manifest-spec

If you prefer, we can set a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the JSON.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Azure Marketplace Ops

--
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Azure Marketplace Ops <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Contoso Partner Success <ps-contoso@example.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace validation request — offer payload + identity proof

Hi Marta — thanks for the checklist and quick turnaround. We're on it. A couple of clarifying Qs before we hand over artifacts:

1) SKU mapping: should the CSV include per-region pricing rows (i.e., separate line for eu-west and eu-north), or do you prefer a single SKU + region column?
2) Identity proof: you mentioned DUNS or tax ID — Contoso asks if a company registration extract (UK Companies House / EU equivalent) is acceptable in lieu of DUNS.
3) Co-sell registration: is there a pre-check that will block us if our offer uses a private VPC deployment option? We have both hosted and private deployment variants and want the hosted plan to be co-sellable.

I've attached a draft-offer.json and an initial sku-mapping.csv to speed things up. We'll upload the org registration PDF once legal signs off (should be today).

Attachments: draft-offer.json (application/json), sku-mapping.csv (text/csv)

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Program Manager, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference
From: Azure Marketplace Ops <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace validation request — offer payload + identity proof

Mina,

Thanks — this is helpful. Quick answers inline:

1) SKU mapping: include region as a separate column and provide per-region rows for pricing if the price differs by region. If pricing is identical, you may use a single row and list supported regions in the regions column.
2) Identity: a government registration extract is acceptable for EU publishers; DUNS is preferred but not strictly required for validation. Please include a notarized stamp if you have it — otherwise a signed company letterhead will do.
3) Private VPC: co-sell is tied to the commercial offer and plan availability. If the hosted plan is publicly listed and meets certification, co-sell will be allowable — make sure the plan manifest flags the private deployment as 'private' and that the hosted plan is a separate plan id with public availability.

I've attached a short sample SKU mapping template and highlighted the manifest fields we validate during the automated pass.

Attachments: sku-template-sample.csv (text/csv), manifest-validation-sample.txt (text/plain)

Next steps: once you confirm the final JSON and identity proof, I'll queue the offer for automated schema validation and ping the co-sell team.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Azure Marketplace Ops
